card.name: The digit 2 in dosing text

modes.label: Number 2 in dose steps
modes.description: The digit 2 giving a count or the start of a number in dose reductions, weight tables or week counts.

modes.label: Section numbers 2.x
modes.description: The dot or digit inside a numbered label for a dosage and administration subsection.
